children: Contango Silver & Gold reported initial 2026 Lucky Shot drill assays including 2.45 m @ 86.05 g/t Au and progress on underground development.
LSS26016 returned 2.45 m grading 86.05 g/t Au, incl. 0.80 m @ 244.30 g/t and 0.30 m @ 49.96 g/t — confirms high-grade Coleman zone.
Five of seven holes showed visible gold; LSS26003 returned 0.50 m @ 81.57 g/t Au supporting Coleman continuity.
Surface program ~5,700 m in 27 holes (~93% of planned 6,000 m); additional assays pending.
Underground development advanced 332 m of 830 m (~40%); 2090W West Drift Extension completed to design for underground drilling.
West Drift encountered two previously unmodeled KM-style veins (KM2, KM3); selective samples up to 395.10 g/t Au from stockpile.
